description: WOFF2 encoding of the adjacent bundled Libertinus fonts; full character repertoire retained, with no subsetting or design changes. Original TTFs and SIL OFL notice remain in the repository.
reproduce: Run woff2_compress on each adjacent .ttf file. The resulting .woff2 files are committed, so website builds do not require a font encoder.
